Security & intelligence
Our technology delivers mobility, adaptive intelligence and resilient communications for security missions. Always-on solutions can be rapidly deployed or withdrawn, ensuring uptime demands of covert and sensitive missions.
Our security-grade mobile satellite network provides in-demand connections to remote and challenging border environments while maintaining command continuity and response capabilities with full mission videos and data transmission.
Emergency response
Kymeta technology provides emergency responders with flexible, resilient communications in crisis situations. Our network offerings, terminal and services solutions offer an adaptable, easy-to-deploy communications environment when in extreme need. This robust communication infrastructure supports first responders, enhancing their ability to coordinate lifesaving efforts and improve emergency response effectiveness.
In times of fire and crisis, Kymeta is ready to deploy terminals offer firefighters and command centers with minimal power requirements. Our technology provides exceptional high-volume data transfer and low-latency sharing and voice communication to enhance situational awareness and firefighting capabilities, even in the most demanding environments.
Kymeta provides robust hybrid connectivity and real-time command insight for defense missions, border security and intelligence operations. Our adaptive solutions ensure critical data and communication remain secure and accessible in dynamic situations.
